canonical_project: FALCON submarine cable landing station, Al Ghaydah (TeleYemen)
notes: Control side: Mahra under Saudi-led-coalition-backed local administration (DCD: FALCON lands in Al Ghaydah, currently under Saudi-led coalition control). Submarine Networks lists TeleYemen Al Ghaydah cable landing station for FALCON (B/A for existence); World Bank 2023 broadband-redundancy study treated FALCON as one of Yemen's only two active subsea cables. Landing station is a small strategic connectivity facility, not a commercial DC; no capacity data.
